references.text: The Lord your God will wipe out the nations before you and give you their land as a possession, a theme repeated in Deuteronomy.
The Lord goes ahead of Israel to drive out the nations and give them the land, the same promise found in 12:29.
The Lord will drive out the nations before Israel, and they will take possession of the land.
When the Lord wipes out the nations and Israel takes their land as a possession and lives in their cities.
Joshua confirms that the Lord has driven out the nations and given Israel the land as an inheritance.
The Lord promises to wipe out the nations in Canaan before Israel.
The Lord will drive out the nations before Israel when they enter the land.
Israel will drive out the inhabitants of the land and live there, for the Lord has given them the land as a possession.
When the Lord brings Israel into the land and gives them cities they did not build and houses full of good things.
The Lord drove out the Amorites who lived in the land before Israel.
